record_hint: Use the MCP tools circuit_record_decision, circuit_record_impression, circuit_record_vision_review, circuit_record_reconcile, circuit_record_read, circuit_record_insight and circuit_record_song_receipt (or `python3 plugins/circuit/scripts/circuit_launcher.py record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with circuit_records_search / circuit_records_digest.
